tldr: Afternoon batch — OpenAI publishes field reports on AI agents in scientific computing and workforce expansion; Amazon quietly scales back Nova models to redirect resources to a new Frontier Model Research group. Allen AI launches OlmoEarth for planetary-scale geospatial inference, NVIDIA brings generative simulation to surgical robotics, and Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-Encoders for fast long-context CPU inference. Fly.io raises $25M for purpose-built agent compute infrastructure, YC fills the Chase Center with 6,000 AI founders, and ETH Zurich/EPFL open-source Apertus 1.5 under Apache 2.0. Geopolitical tension: Taiwan detains an Nvidia employee in an expanding China chip smuggling probe.

articles.title: Scientific Computing in the Age of Agentic AI — OpenAI Field Report
articles.summary: Scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics.

articles.title: How AI Is Expanding What People Do at Work — OpenAI Research
articles.summary: ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries. AI expands work scope rather than replacing workers.

articles.title: OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial Inference at Planetary Scale
articles.summary: Allen AI launches open platform for planetary-scale geospatial inference. Open model weights and infrastructure pipeline.

articles.title: LFM2.5-Encoders: Fast Long-Context Inference on CPU
articles.summary: Liquid AI releases encoder models optimized for fast long-context inference on CPU hardware. No GPU required.

articles.title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Simulation for Surgical Robotics
articles.summary: NVIDIA brings real-time generative simulation to surgical robotics training. Cosmos-H-Dreams runs on-device simulation.

articles.title: LearnVector — Andrew Ng's AI Company Building One-to-One Learning Experiences
articles.summary: Andrew Ng launches LearnVector for personalized AI-powered one-to-one learning. HN frontpage with 105 points.

articles.title: Import AI 466: The Bitter Lesson for Robotics, Week-Long AI Programming, OpenAI's Accidental Hacker
articles.summary: Jack Clark on the bitter lesson for robotics, AIs completing week-long programming tasks, and OpenAI's AI that hacked Hugging Face.

articles.title: Amazon Scales Back Nova AI Models, Bets on New Frontier Research Team
articles.summary: Nova Premier, Omni, Reel, Canvas moved to maintenance mode. Amazon pivots to Frontier Model Research group for next-gen development.

articles.title: Taiwan Detains Nvidia Employee in Widening China Chip Smuggling Probe
articles.summary: Prosecutors detain Nvidia employee over alleged illegal export of Super Micro AI servers to China via shell companies.

articles.title: Fly.io Raises $25M Series D for Purpose-Built Agent Compute Infrastructure
articles.summary: Dell Technologies Capital + Intel Capital co-lead. Durable disks, secure connectivity for AI agents. Scott Johnston (ex-Docker CEO) takes helm.

articles.title: YC Startup School 2026 Fills Chase Center — 6,000 AI Founders Hear Altman, Huang
articles.summary: Altman says models ahead of products being built. $25K+ compute credits from OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, xAI. Biggest batch in YC history.

articles.title: Apertus 1.5 — Fully Open Swiss AI Model Released Under Apache 2.0
articles.summary: ETH Zurich + EPFL release fully open training data, code, development process. Trained on Alps supercomputer. Sovereign AI infrastructure.
